expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Planned v2 work will explore richer protocol messages while preserving the current `Ping` behavior, with candidate fields such as `request_id` for correlating requests and responses, `timestamp` for recording message timing, and an optional `payload` for message-specific data; these fields are under consideration only and are not part of the current implementation.
Shipped v2 Hello with the explicit `v:2|hello:<name>` envelope.
